map.精子 DNA 碎片指数 DFI 与高 DNA 可染性 HDS 均按百分比分级：D: Sperm DNA Fragmentation Index (DFI) and High DNA Stainability (HDS) are graded by percentage: the lower the DFI, the better the DNA integrity; elevated HDS suggests a higher proportion of immature sperm and abnormal spermatogenesis.
map.💡 DFI 参考：<15% 优秀，15~25% 一般，25~50% 较差，>50: 💡 DFI reference: <15% excellent, 15-25% fair, 25-50% poor, >50% very poor. HDS (High DNA Stainability) reflects chromatin immaturity and is often interpreted together with DFI.
map.DFI 检测方法包括 SCD、TUNEL、SCSA 等，不同方法参考范围略有差异: DFI testing methods include SCD, TUNEL and SCSA; reference ranges vary slightly between methods.
map.DFI 升高与复发性流产、受精率低、胚胎质量下降等风险相关。: Elevated DFI is associated with risks such as recurrent miscarriage, low fertilization rate and reduced embryo quality.
map.建议结合精液常规参数、年龄、生活方式及临床病史综合评估。: It is recommended to combine routine semen parameters, age, lifestyle and clinical history for a comprehensive assessment.
map.DFI<30%（部分实验室<15% 更优）、HDS<15% → 均正常，DNA: DFI<30% (some labs prefer <15%) and HDS<15%: both normal, good DNA integrity and chromatin structure.
map.DFI≥30% 提示碎片升高，反复不良妊娠风险增加，建议抗氧化与生活方式干预后复: DFI>=30% indicates elevated fragmentation and increased risk of repeated adverse pregnancy; consider antioxidant and lifestyle intervention before recheck.
map.DFI 反映 DNA 断裂碎片比例，HDS 反映未成熟染色质（高可染性）比例。: DFI reflects the proportion of DNA breakage fragments; HDS reflects the proportion of immature chromatin (high stainability).
map.常用 DFI<15–30%、HDS<15% 为正常区间，越高越差。: Commonly DFI<15-30% and HDS<15% are considered normal ranges; higher values are worse.
